# Add Chain [chains.add]

Adds an EVM chain to the wallet.

## Usage

This example adds an EVM chain to the wallet.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"ff4e9cc7cbb76d7bab242fee99ab554a99b321d4965ca65e036600bac7d04376","data":""}
import { optimism } from 'viem/chains'
import { client } from './viem.config'

await client.chains.add({ chain: optimism })
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"26a87f0a9844bc3d88b1d6fd619cbdb031f85e9bfc04b1bbf94cc056cba6339b","data":""}
import { Client, custom, walletActions } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'

export const client = Client.create({
  transport: custom(window.ethereum!),
}).extend(walletActions())
```

:::

### Standalone Action

Call `Actions.chains.add` directly by passing the Client as the first argument.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a9f7defa359c4de177d2d32338639d737a3b839fefcdfc6fc5777c8a4b21ea5f","data":""}
import { Actions } from 'viem'
import { optimism } from 'viem/chains'
import { client } from './viem.config'

await Actions.chains.add(client, { chain: optimism })
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"12595c699c2063a0164307040b735be033c97b855307a33b07857d058d280890","data":""}
import { Client, custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'

export const client = Client.create({
  transport: custom(window.ethereum!),
})
```

:::

## Return Value

`void`

No value is returned.

## Parameters

### chain

- **Type:** `Chain`

The chain to add to the wallet.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"098beb1e4efcace4543bb5badf0d4efb670483b782d9cecad5103c2b99b0b5d6","data":""}
import { Actions } from 'viem'
import { optimism } from 'viem/chains'
// [!include ~/snippets/docs/reference-client.ts:setup]
// ---cut---
await Actions.chains.add(client, {
  chain: optimism, // [!code focus]
})
```
